g.text: Flash Sale: Reject as Early as Possible
Each layer is cheaper to reject at than the one after it
9,000 rejected -- one atomic memory op each
Every request the database sees costs the SAME whether it succeeds or fails -- so the design's entire job is losing the 499,000
failing requests as early and as cheaply as possible, not making the database fast enough to absorb all 500,000 of them.
